The '''lahn''' (symbol: {{lahn}}; [[wikipedia:ISO 4217|ISO code]] '''LND''') is the official currency of [[Dahe]] and one of the two principal '''globally backed reserve currencies''' of [[Andah]], paired with the [[Raledrian Kasare]] of [[Raledria]]. It is issued by the [[Central Bank of Fekunza]] and is used as the standard unit of account by the [[Global Trade Union]] in the publication of nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] and [[List of countries by GDP (PPP)|GDP (PPP)]] tables.

The lahn is the unit in which the [[FLLA]] reports tournament revenue, sponsorship and host-nation budgets, including the budgets and final accounts of every [[FLLA World Cup]] from the [[1740 FLLA World Cup|1740 edition]] onwards, and is the unit of account for the [[Global Trade Union]]'s Economic Outlook database.

==History==

==Reserve status==

The lahn is one of two currencies recognised by the [[Global Trade Union]] as a primary global reserve, the other being the [[Raledrian Kasare]] of [[Raledria]]. The two reserve currencies between them account for the substantial majority of central-bank foreign-exchange holdings reported to the [[Global Trade Union]] by member states.
